Package com.datastax.dse.driver.api.core.cql.reactive

Interface ReactiveSession

  • All Superinterfaces:
    AsyncAutoCloseable, AutoCloseable, Session
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    CqlSession, DseSession
    public interface ReactiveSession
extends Session
    A Session that offers utility methods to issue queries using reactive-style programming.

    Methods in this interface all return ReactiveResultSet instances. See the javadocs of this interface for important remarks anc caveats regarding the subscription to and consumption of reactive result sets.

    See Also:
    ReactiveResultSet, ReactiveRow

        Returns a Publisher that, once subscribed to, executes the given query and emits all the results.

      • executeReactive

        @NonNull
default ReactiveResultSet executeReactive​(@NonNull
                                          String query,
                                          @NonNull
                                          Object... values)
        Returns a Publisher that, once subscribed to, executes the given query and emits all the results.

        This is an alias for executeReactive(Statement) executeReactive(SimpleStatement.newInstance(query, values))}.

        Parameters:
        query - the query to execute.
        values - the values for placeholders in the query string. Individual values can be null, but the vararg array itself can't.
        Returns:
        The Publisher that will publish the returned results.
        See Also:
        SimpleStatement.newInstance(String,Object...)
